profile.headline: AWS Architect and Technical Lead
profile.summary:
The Architect and Full Stack Developer for Front-End/Back-End application

Lead and manage software development team, plan strategies, create prototype, drive implementation of project, and deliver efficient IT systems.

11 years software development experience with proficiency in .Net Technologies (Web and Desktop) including 6 Years investment/financial domain experience.

Strong in Angular, MVC , C#, ASP.NET 4.5/4.0/3.5/2.0/1, Web-Forms, RESTfull Services, WebAPI , WCF, WebServices,  XML, AJAX, JQuery, Javascript, ADO.Net, SQL Server 2005/2008, Database design, TFS.

Extensive experience in SQL Server Database design, Database maintenance, developing T-SQL queries, stored procedures, and triggers using SQL Server 2005/2008/2012, DB2, Oracle

Good experience with cloud computing, worked on APEX development, Salesforce and .net integration

Good experience of working with International clients at offshore and onsite VISRI Japan, ARIG Bahrain, Giant-Eagle and  BOA USA.

Knowledge of SSIS, SSAS, SSRS,  Experience with analyzing business requirements and designing software architecture with Object oriented, Service oriented and multi-tier architecture 

Ability to adapt new technologies and applications proficiently. Excellent analytical skills, good problem solving capabilities with positive attitude & committed to meet deadlines.
